resources.string: How high or deep the voice sounds. Natural is the voice as it was made. A change is heard at once, without starting the sentence again, and speed never changes it. The slider and the − and + buttons go up to 15% either way, where a voice still sounds like itself; the one-tap choices stop at 10%. Saved audiobooks, clips, studio files and talking books use it too. With This book\'s own settings on, each book keeps its own pitch.
Heard at once. Speed never changes it.
